claim: ATT&CK holds the attack matrix alongside catalogues of named attacker groups and their campaigns, each group characterised by the techniques observed across its operations.
quote: Such activities are classified as belonging to _groups_ or **Advanced Persistent Threat (APTs)** , thus an APT is characterized by a sequence of malicious activities—this one constituting the behavior of the adversary.
issue: Al-Sada supports the matrix (Fig. 1) and groups characterised by their observed activities, and links software to groups ("WannaCry-S0366 ... G0032-Lazarous Group", same page). It never mentions campaigns. That part rests on mitre2026attackkb, whose saved copy shows only a "Campaigns" menu entry.
